original: asipadamahāmantrasya mana ṛṣiḥ | gāyatrī chandaḥ | ardhanārīśvaro devatā | avyaktādirbījam | nṛsiṃhaḥ śaktiḥ | paramātmā kīlakam | jīvabrahmaikyārthe jape viniyogaḥ | pṛthvīdvyaṇukāya aṅguṣṭhābhyāṃ namaḥ | abdvyaṇukāya tarjanībhyāṃ svāhā | tejodvyaṇukāya madhyamābhyāṃ vaṣaṭ | vāyudvyaṇukāya anāmikābhyaṃ hum |
